about: An Ozone preset is XML. Its root names the era and plug-in that wrote it (Ozone9Maximizer, Ozone10, OzoneMS); each module is an element with Enabled, holding Param elements (ElementID, ParamID, Value) and base64 ExtraBytes for what isn't a number. The saved state is different: a 16-byte header and zlib-compressed JSON in which every value is typed. Its DSP State/DSP Elements carries each module's settings under the same ElementIDs and ParamIDs a preset uses, with more besides.

layers: XML text with a declaration; the root's PresetVer and PluginVer give the preset format and the Ozone that wrote it (PluginVer 9030 is Ozone 9.3, 120000 Ozone 12)
a module element per module: Enabled, then Param ElementID ParamID Value, and ExtraBytes ElementID Data (base64)
the Global element's ExtraBytes "ElementChain": the signal chain, each module as a flag byte (0), a u32 LE length and its ElementID
u32 LE 0x00688ADE, a constant in every state seen
u32 LE: the length of everything after the first 12 bytes
u32 LE: the JSON's length once decoded

a zlib stream of JSON: every value as {"Type": Float, UInt, Bool, String, Base64, Dictionary or Array, "Value": …}; Context State (the window, per module), DSP State/DSP Elements (the settings), Major Version and Minor Version
Live keeps it as hex in the Set's Vst3Preset/ProcessorState; the ControllerState is empty
